prompt_proof.scope: Instruction token rows and converted BF16 prompt embeddings only; not native model/policy parity, action semantics or environment compatibility

semantics.full: full27 vision, full18 VLM, original18 AE, uniformD10
semantics.learned: shared full27 vision and native language preencoder plus learned state path; one fixed released draft head, no VLM/AE/verify/fallback
semantics.images: RGB already oriented by client, no LIBERO flips
semantics.prefix: fresh each request; no cross-request KV reuse
semantics.graphs: full constructor capture disabled; draft graph disabled to count actual eager route calls

policy_receipt.limitations: CPU prompt and metadata checks do not establish policy or environment/action mapping parity

seed_rule: same case seed and replan RNG seed across conditions; no mode in seed

model_controls.drafts: All four released suite heads, pure draft, no VLM/action-expert/verify

selection: All six conditions retained; no training, head selection or adaptation on target environments

budget.origin: self-imposed exploratory cap including preparation; not a user-specified E4 budget

metrics.success: Native oracle, separate denominator per environment; technical/unsupported never zero-policy outcomes
metrics.pusht: Explicit 2D stress projection, not directly comparable to arm task success
metrics.latency: Same case/condition on same GPU shard; compare only within shard; cold/compile separate

videos: case0 in every environment, every condition; full-stream decode validation; fixed selection independent of outcome
interpretation: Full baseline zero/unsupported adapter makes generalization inference inconclusive; no causal model-capacity claims
